name: Question 10
problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{D}\frac{{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}A,$ where 
$D={(x,y)\,:\,{e}^{2}\le x\le {e}^{4},\,0\le y\le \sqrt[3]{6}}.$
worked_solution:
First, we express our double integral as a repeated integral:      

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}\frac{{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}[{\int }_{{e}^{2}}^{{e}^{4}}\frac{{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}[{\int }_{{e}^{2}}^{{e}^{4}}\frac{{y}^{2}}{x}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}{y}^{2}[{\int }_{{e}^{2}}^{{e}^{4}}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}{y}^{2}[\operatorname{ln}⁡x]_{{e}^{2}}^{{e}^{4}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}{y}^{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡{e}^{4}-\operatorname{ln}⁡{e}^{2})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}{y}^{2}\cdot 2\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}2{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}}2{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y & =\frac{2}{3}[{y}^{3}]_{0}^{\sqrt[3]{6}} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}((\sqrt[3]{6})^{3}-{0}^{3}) \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluate the double integral ∬Dy2xdA, where D={(x,y):e2≤x≤e4,0≤y≤63}.

Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we express our double integral as a repeated integral:

∬Dy2xdA=∫063[∫e2e4y2xdx]dy

Now, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to x, treating y as a constant:

∫063[∫e2e4y2xdx]dy=∫063y2[∫e2e41xdx]dy=∫063y2[ln⁡x]e2e4dy=∫063y2(ln⁡e4−ln⁡e2)dy=∫063y2⋅2dy=∫0632y2dy

Finally, we integrate with respect to y:

∫0632y2dy=23[y3]063=23((63)3−03)=4
